cds.title: Bucknell University Common Data Set 2025-26 (PDF, Institutional Research & Analytics; the file's running header still says 2024-2025 but its data are for fall 2025)

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs for 2026-27 from the Common Data Set (G1, G5); Bucknell's tuition page shows the same direct charges (tuition $72,600, housing $11,400, approximate meal plan $6,980, student fee $900). Room and board = housing $11,400 + meal plan $6,980 (the CDS 'food and housing' figure). Estimated expenses: books and supplies $900; other shown = transportation $800 + other expenses $2,000. Total cost of attendance $95,648 is the 2026-27 budget on Bucknell's tuition page (it includes $68 of loan fees if borrowing). Bucknell's financial-aid page for international students lists a 2026-27 educational expense budget of $97,716, which adds approximate health insurance ($2,136). CDS H6: 130 degree-seeking undergraduate nonresidents received need-based or non-need-based institutional aid, average $71,387 (total $9,280,357).

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2025 entering class; the PDF's page header still reads 'Common Data Set 2024-2025', but C1 and B1 say Fall 2025): 11,561 applied, 3,723 admitted (32.2%), 1,037 enrolled; the male/female/unknown rows and the residency rows (Pennsylvania, other states, international, unknown) add up to these totals. International first-years: 2,631 applied, 156 admitted, 42 enrolled. Two applicants had an unknown residency (none admitted). Waitlist: 2,908 offered a place, 1,384 accepted, 150 admitted. Early Decision (both plans together, C21): 1,200 applications, 656 admitted; no Early Action. SAT/ACT are optional: 68% of first-years (710 students) submitted SAT and 18% (190 students) submitted ACT scores. The percentiles are the CDS ones; Bucknell's admission-requirements page quotes a higher middle 50% for the Class of 2028 (SAT reading/writing 670-740, math 670-760, ACT 31-34), so treat the ranges as approximate. GPA: average 3.58 on a 4.0 scale, all first-years reported one; the bands (all enrolled students) add up to 100% (the 'below 1.0' row is blank). The CDS marks no importance for 'Recommendation(s)' in C7, so that factor is left blank. Undergraduate enrollment (3,928) is the CDS 'Total all undergraduates' (B1; 3,888 degree-seeking); the international count (168) is the nonresident total (B2; 163 degree-seeking).
